title: After Dune Delight | Gulf View Seagrove Condo | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: After Dune Delight is a pet-friendly Gulf-view condo in Seagrove with renovated interiors, pools, tennis, and quick access to beach and dining.
description_expanded: After Dune Delight Gulf View Condo Steps from the Sand in Seagrove Home Introduction Experience relaxed coastal living at After Dune Delight , a fully renovated designer condo with sweeping Gulf views and unbeatable beach access . Located in the heart of Seagrove just south of 30A, this inviting retreat offers resort-style amenities , easy access to Eastern Lake, and close proximity to local dining and shopping . Home Highlights · Gulf Views - Enjoy stunning views from the living room, balcony, and king suite · Beach Proximity - Approximately 100 yards to the beach with multiple nearby access points · Fully Renovated Interior - Updated finishes and thoughtfully designed spaces throughout · Resort Amenities - Two community pools , including one heated seasonally · Sports Courts - Tennis, pickleball, shuffleboard, and cornhole available · Pet Friendly - Up to 2 small non-shedding dogs with approval and fee · Complimentary Beach Gear - 4 backpack chairs and 1 umbrella provided · Outdoor Living - Covered balcony with cushioned seating and dining for 2 · Full Kitchen - High-end appliances and fully stocked for cooking · Bar Area - Includes ice maker and beverage fridge · Dining Space - Seating for 6 plus breakfast bar for 2 · In-Unit Laundry - Washer and dryer included · Next to Eastern Lake - Unique opportunity to enjoy both lake and Gulf experiences · Bike Friendly Location - Easy access to nearby dining, coffee shops, and markets · Parking - Space for 2 vehicles (no trailers, RVs, or street parking) Location Perks · 5 minute or less bike ride to local favorites including dining, coffee, and seafood markets · 1.5 blocks to Eastern Lake Beach Access with seasonal shuttle service · 4 minute bike ride to Walton Dunes Beach Access with parking and beach service · Close to shopping and dining at Greenway Station and surrounding Seagrove area Know Before You Go · A mid-stay clean is required for reservations of 10 days or longer and is included in your stay · Additional cleanings are available for an extra fee · Seasonal shuttle service to Eastern Lake Beach Access runs mid March through October from 9 AM to 5 PM · Golf cart rentals are limited to the community's approved vendor · Construction, renovations, or nearby projects may occur and are outside of management control · No refunds or discounts are provided for construction-related disruptions ***Pets are welcome with prior approval by Exclusive 30A. Please request your pet’s stay at time of reservation. Payment of our non-refundable pet fee must be paid at time of approval.***

Full Guest Bath | combo shower/tub. Hallway access
King Suite | Gulf view from bed, reach in closet, private entrance to balcony, en suite bath
Queen Guest Room | TV, hallway access to full bath
